description: Multi-node operations dashboard for Scroll L2 Reth/rollup-node v1.0.7-rc6 (bc3d5006c41b38cc442ebe92d1afc4285fc43ca1). Official single-node dashboards are adapted separately from https://github.com/scroll-tech/rollup-node/tree/v1.0.7-rc6/docker-compose/resource/dashboards

options.content:
### Scroll L2 Reth fleet

This view compares all deployed rollup-node workloads:

- 2 sequencers
- 2 RPC services
- 2 bootnodes

Use this dashboard for fleet-level health and divergence. Use the linked upstream-adapted dashboards for a single-pod drill-down.

[Overview](/d/scroll-l2-reth-overview) · [Rollup node](/d/scroll-l2-rollup-node) · [Performance](/d/scroll-l2-reth-performance) · [State & history](/d/scroll-l2-reth-state-history) · [Transaction pool](/d/scroll-l2-reth-transaction-pool)
